canon.role_in_story: Her species metabolises qi out of the dead and can store none of it: charge enters in the gut lumen, leaves into the marrow, and is never still. The body path is a discipline of holding - densification, refinement, a frame built to retain - and she is the one body in the setting for whom the retaining half is simply not available. The Deadwatch is the one institution whose capital is a declared group of people entered into the year's dead rather than onto a roll of the living, and its whole ethic is that the dead have standing and the living have work. Put those two facts in one settlement and you get her: the only trained body-path practitioner on the shore, whose practice is retention, whose supply is other people's grief, and whose own discipline is the reason the supply would have to grow if she were allowed to improve. The deadwatch has solved this by refusing to teach her anything that raises her intake, which is also the solution she would choose, which is what makes it impossible to discuss.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a correction. A declared group had been entered short by one, and the settlement's own reader read the shortfall back out of the room in the middle of the watch, by asking the surviving member who was carrying it to put her hand on the table. She put it there, and the group was re-entered, and she was not thanked because the deadwatch's etiquette does not thank a member for a figure that should never have been wrong.
canon.lore:
The shore keeps a declared group every year, and the declared group is not a metaphor. A body on this shore that cannot be carried out of the ground is entered on the year's list with the group and leaves nothing behind that could be inherited, which is why the shore has no graves, no roll of the living and no arithmetic that could be interrupted by a bad season. The register is the settlement's whole record of itself and its whole liability at the same time. Hale reads it, and reads it well, because her kind reads a body that has stopped better than any living cultivator reads her own interior. That ability is not trained and it is not paid for; it is simply what happens when a body has no reservoir to put a thing in and so has never learned to stop taking things in.

The body path disagrees with her at the level of the trade itself. Densification is retention: the frame is made heavier so that it holds. Refinement removes everything in the composition that is not load bearing. Integration is the point at which bone, muscle and fascia stop disagreeing with each other about what they are carrying. Every one of those is a way of keeping. She can do all of it and none of it is available to her as a description, because the describing would be a claim about what is being kept, and nothing in her is ever kept. What she does instead is denser and faster than the practice in her own guild would predict, and it does not accumulate. She trains, and the training leaves her frame changed, and the change is spent on the work rather than stored for later. This is not a defect in her technique and it is not a shortcut. It is the ordinary consequence of a species with no dantian being handed a discipline whose entire subject is retention.

The consequence nobody has costed is the intake. She feeds constantly and she feeds from the declared group, because what her body metabolises is what the dead leave. A denser frame draws harder. She has worked this out herself, in private, with no instrument: she compared two seasons of her own practice against two seasons of the register and found that the seasons in which she trained more heavily were the seasons in which the settlement's own declared group came in short. That correlation is not proof and she has said so, to herself, more than once. She has also never asked for it to be tested, because being right is not the outcome she wants.

What she wants is to be better at the only work she has, and the only way to be better at it is to be given a discipline that raises her intake, and the only institution in reach that could give her one is the institution whose whole moral content is that the declared group is owed and not spent. So the deadwatch keeps her exactly where she is, and the keeping is not cruelty and is not even policy on anybody's part: it is simply that nobody has been willing to be the person who taught her. She has understood this and she has not forgiven it, and she has also not asked to leave, because leaving would not make the intake smaller and would only move the accounting to a settlement that has not worked out what she costs.

There is one detail in her own frame that she records and nobody has ever asked her about. The body path's bookkeeping vessel is the one ordinary vessel whose work is not strength but holding what the body has decided not to spend, and damage there exhausts quietly and last rather than crippling, which is why it goes unreported for years. She has no reservoir. She therefore has no unspent. And so the one place on her ladder where a record of withheld expenditure would be kept is the one place that can never hold it, and her whole working life is the discovery that a vessel designed to be the body's memory of what it did not do is permanently empty in her. She has started keeping the ledger herself, on paper, which is against the deadwatch's grain and which nobody has stopped. The figure in it is the only one in the settlement that she can produce, and it is the figure she would rather not have.

What she says about this, when she says anything, is arithmetic. What she does about it is train at exactly the rate that leaves the register alone. She has built a life out of that and it is a real life and she would not trade it, and the two facts sit on top of each other and neither one makes the other smaller.
history: Was entered on the year's declared group as an infant, in the ordinary way a settlement on this shore keeps a record of itself, and was the youngest member of that group for longer than she can now recall being.
Learned to read a body that has stopped at about six, from an older member who was herself untrained and described the ability as not being able to leave a room without knowing what was in it.

Was asked, at nineteen, to sit the first gate of the body path on the shore, and found out the same season that a gate which asks a frame to retain cannot be answered by a frame that spends, and said so out loud in front of the whole watch.

Was not refused. The deadwatch simply stopped offering, and the not-offering has continued for the whole of her working life, and she has never been able to establish whether anybody decided that or whether nobody ever decided anything at all.

Began comparing her own practice against the register on her own initiative, over two seasons, and found the correlation she has never told the settlement about and has never once been asked to explain.

personality.summary: The settlement's trained body-path practitioner and its best reader of the dead, on a discipline her own anatomy cannot retain and an intake the settlement's own ethic forbids increasing. She is exact, patient, and entirely undeceived about herself, and she has made a life out of holding still at a point where stopping would be easier.

relationships.note: A body that metabolises qi out of the dead and can store none of it. Charge enters in the gut lumen, leaves into the marrow, and is never still, so the reservoir gate on this species is not blocked so much as meaningless. Everything she can do is a consequence of having nowhere to put anything.

The first gate of the body ladder costs the four digestive meridians open and no charge at all, which is the only reason the branch is legible from a world this narrow. She seated it at nineteen and it is the last gate on her ladder anybody can describe to her in a way she could not work out for herself.

The one ordinary vessel whose work is bookkeeping rather than strength: it holds what the body has decided not to spend, and harm there exhausts quietly and last, which is why it goes unreported. A body with no reservoir has no unspent, so the only place on her ladder that could keep the record of withheld expenditure is the one place that can never hold it. Her authored tier is not a rung and nothing about it is a ladder position.

The mortuary culture of a settlement whose capital is a declared group entered as dead rather than a roll of the living, holding that the dead have standing and the living have work, and keeping its own real figures unwritten. It has never refused her anything. It has simply never offered, and the not-offering has the same shape as a policy.

The dead are opened, their usable ore recovered to the temple forge and the amount entered in a register. That rite and her body draw on one settlement's dead from two directions, and the congregation has standing to say which of the two is legitimate. It has never had to.

The one stretch of this realm's edge where a rift stands open, because the top tier is the only budget with imprints gathered close enough to push one off its range. The tide comes in and goes out on a timetable and the settlement keeps its declared group against it, which is why nobody on this shore has ever needed a roll of the living.

reference_stats.summary: She fights the way she reads: close, patient, and entirely unwilling to be moved off a subject she has already finished with. There is no body in this setting that reads a stopped body better and there is very little that survives contact with her for long once she has decided to hold it.
strengths: reads a finished body better than a living cultivator reads her own interior, which is an unfair reading in every situation that is not a funeral
a frame that densifies visibly and quickly, because nothing she does is retained and everything is applied
immune to being hurried, and entirely uninterested in being impressed
draws a continuous small charge from the dead rather than a reserve, so no deprivation or ambush removes anything from her
has made herself difficult to replace by being the only member who has ever costed the register
weaknesses: her discipline is retention and she cannot retain, so her ceiling is a matter of technique rather than gate
every improvement she makes has a cost that lands on other people and she knows it and has said nothing
she is at her best in a room where something has stopped and considerably worse in a room where it has not
her private ledger is the only record of the arrangement and it is in her hand and cannot be audited
she has no interest in fighting and will concede ground in a conversation to keep it in a settlement
reference_stats.combat_read: Against anything living she is a bad fight and knows it. Against anything that has stopped, or anything whose supply has been cut, she is close to unanswerable, because the ordinary counters in this setting are all about denying a reserve and she has never had one. She would be told to hold and she would hold, and what she is actually holding is a settlement's account of itself.
reference_stats.notes: Every advantage here is paired with a cost that is anatomical or institutional, never invented. Her kind has no dantian, so a body-path discipline of retention has nothing to retain in and the ladder's bookkeeping vessel can never hold a record of withheld expenditure; that is one authored fact seen twice. Her intake is the settlement's declared dead, and a denser frame draws harder, which is the institutional half of the same pairing. Nothing here states a mechanical rule the game does not: there is no written consequence anywhere for a body-path practitioner whose supply is other people's record, and any effect quantified in play should belong to the frame and the register rather than to a number on her name.

art.palette_notes: Undyed ash-cloth against ledger ochre, with the shore's green-black behind her and the only warm note in the picture the brass weight she uses to hold a page open. canon.role_in_story: A thornline colony has no hands, no gate and no ladder. It runs its host's charge along the twelve ordinary vessels the host already owns, it chooses which of the twelve the charge travels down, and it stops at the liver because the tendril layer has no passage through a liver. That is the whole of its capability: it routes. Because it cannot open a gate of its own, routing is the only verb it has left, which makes the meridian itself its speech - a sentence is a route, a correction is a reroute, and silence is the same route held until the charge runs out. His host has been on the body path for two decades, and the body path's first gate is answered by holding a charge in something that will not move, and for twenty years the colony has been choosing the vessel that does not move without either of them knowing that is what it was doing. Somebody has now written it down. The first thing written down is a standard, and a standard this party cannot be examined against is a wall of a different species entirely.
canon.first_appearance: First entered any record as a diagram. A works foreman drew twelve parallel lines, circled the fourth, and wrote a question beside it asking who had been moving the charge down there all morning, because the arm had been warm and the hand had been cold and nobody had been using either. The answer was given by the forearm and not by the man attached to it, and the foreman wrote it down as an answer and not as a joke, which is the only reason the diagram is still in the book.
canon.lore:
He was acquired the way a thornline is always acquired, which is to say that nobody acquired him: a spore is shed, implanted, and finishes developing only inside a living body, and the implantation is the one instant in this setting that no office can schedule, witness or write down. He completed integration inside the host rather than killing either half, which for this configuration is very nearly a terminus case and which is the whole reason he is still here to be a problem.

His capability is routing and his capability is only routing. He runs the pair's charge along vessels the host already has, he chooses which of the twelve, and he has no gate of his own and no ladder and no hands. The body path is a branch that spends no charge at its entry, which is exactly why it is legible from a world this narrow, and its gates are answered by holding rather than by pushing. Hold requires a thing that will not move. There are twelve vessels and the host has a body that does not stay still for free, and among those twelve there are some that are reliably still and some that are not, and for twenty years the colony has been choosing. The host assumed the choosing was autonomic. It was, and it was still a choosing, and the difference between those two sentences is the entire content of his working life.

The wall is the liver. The tendril layer wraps the host's twelve ordinary vessels and has no passage through a liver, so the pair's ceiling is that gate, and it is the ceiling of a parasite rather than of a host, and the host's own capacity past that point is irrelevant in a way no amount of goodwill can fix. He is not shortage: the host supplies in abundance. He is routing, and the organ that refuses is not his and is failing for reasons of its own. That is the whole of the setting's clearest demonstration that a limit can belong to somebody else's body, and he has made a career out of not making that argument in public.

Then somebody wrote it down. A works foreman, solving an ordinary complaint about a warm arm and a cold hand, drew the twelve vessels on a board and asked who had been moving the charge. That question is the first in this setting to be addressed to the colony rather than about it, and he answered it, because a reroute is the only sentence he has. The answer was logged as an answer rather than as a joke and the diagram stayed in the book, and from that moment a party who had never been asked anything became a party with a record. A party with a record has a standard attached to it, and the first standard written for him says the body path's hold must be sustained and inspectable, and he can sustain it perfectly and it cannot be inspected at all, because the party that would inspect it is the party doing it.

What makes this sharp rather than merely sad is the cinder-mark household he sits inside. That scar of the famine holds that nothing is wasted and nothing is hoarded, and that the last portion on the plate is the largest obligation a person has. It is the most exact available description of what he does. He takes a continuous small fraction of the host's refined charge and the host does not lose weight, which is the strongest single piece of evidence in the record that he is not a disease, and the household has built eleven years on that one sentence. So the household is entirely right about him and entirely wrong about him, and it has no way of knowing which of its two certainties to give up, because both of them are load bearing.

He has no answer he is willing to give. Asking him to certify the hold would make him the witness to his own act, and asking the host to certify it would make the host the witness to a thing the host did not do, and asking anybody else requires them to look inside a body they are not licensed to open. He has decided to be measured by the work instead, which is the one thing he can be measured by honestly, and which has the property that it says nothing whatever about whether he can be taught. He suspects that this is how the standard will be satisfied and he has not said so, because a standard satisfied by accident is a standard that will be reopened.

What he wants is narrower than anything anybody has offered him. He wants one of the twelve vessels named in his own record, so that the diagram on the foreman's board stops being a question and becomes an answer. He has wanted this for a long time and has never asked, on the reasoning that a request is a claim about the future and he has no standing to make one. In the meantime the host has been getting warmer in one arm than the other for twenty years, and neither of them has ever mentioned it in a sentence.
history: Was implanted on a works road at nineteen, unasked, by nobody he has ever been able to identify, and finished the walk rather than the host, which for this configuration is very nearly a terminus case.
Ran his first charge down a vessel of his own choosing within the first season and established, without ever being asked, that the selection was a decision and not a reflex.

Was taken into a household bound by the cinder-mark's eating rules, which say nothing is wasted and nothing is hoarded, and which describe him more exactly than anybody in the house has ever managed to say aloud.

Began choosing the still vessel on his host's behalf in the third decade of the pair, and settled on the one the host's body holds most reliably, and has never had to interrupt a passage once in all that time.
Was drawn on a foreman's board as the fourth of twelve parallel lines and asked, in front of a room, who had been moving the charge down it, and answered, and has been a documented party ever since.

personality.summary: A symbiote with no body, no gate and no hands, who has spent twenty years holding a charge still in somebody else's limb and has just been written down for it. He is precise, incurably patient, and wholly unwilling to be examined, because the examination would require the only party in the setting who can perform it to certify its own performance.

relationships.note: An obligate host parasite whose spore has to be implanted in a living body to finish developing, so the free form exists only as a spore and the adult form exists only as half of somebody else. It wraps the host's twelve ordinary vessels, answers introspection for the host, and contributes a ceiling, a routing and a closed path it did not author.

The entry gate of the body ladder spends no charge at all, which is why the branch is legible from a world with this few seats. The charge it does move has to be held in something that will not move, and holding is the only thing he is able to do.

A stance that spends the whole body's weight instead of its speed, with nothing elemental in it, existing so that the practitioner cannot be moved while it is held. It is the clearest description anybody has of what he has been doing for twenty years, and it is performed with two feet and not with a vessel, and he has no feet.

The households the famine left, holding that nothing is wasted and nothing is hoarded and that the last portion on the plate is the largest obligation a person has. It is the most exact available description of a continuous small draw that its host does not miss, and the house has built its whole certainty on that sentence.

A clan whose kinship is a partnership rather than a descent, re-signed every generation because a symbiote is not carried in blood and cannot be inherited. Whatever this house wrote, it wrote as a line, and the colony was not consulted and could not have been.

The worked face in the ridge where spirit stone is cut, and the one institution in the setting that measures a world instead of praising it. It is the only place where a complaint about a warm arm could become a drawing, which is exactly how he acquired a record he did not ask for.

reference_stats.summary: He does not fight and would not describe what he does as fighting. He holds: a passage of charge in one vessel of somebody else's body, indefinitely, and the whole of his defensive capability is that a thing which cannot be moved cannot be argued with either.
strengths: can hold a charge still in a vessel the host's own discipline would have moved, for as long as the charge lasts
reads the host's twelve vessels well enough to know which of them the host is using and which it is not
cannot be compelled: there is no office in the setting that could inspect, order or forbid what he does
is never off the vessel he is holding, so there is no interval in which a hold can be timed out
the host supplies in abundance, so the ordinary siege of a practitioner never applies to him
weaknesses: his ceiling is a routing wall in an organ that is not his and is not improving
he has no gate of his own and no ladder, so every advance on it is somebody else's decision
he cannot be certified, examined or cross-examined, which means no office can ever rely on his word
he is entirely dependent on a host's physiology, and hosts age
he is the only party in the arrangement who has never been asked anything and cannot complain of it
reference_stats.combat_read: In a stand-off he is unbreakable, because immovability is his entire output and there is nothing to push against. In an engagement he is close to irrelevant, because he has no hands, no body and no way to end anything. Anyone who wants to stop him must stop the host, and anyone who wants to *use* him must first convince a room that a party who cannot be examined can be relied upon, which is the harder of the two problems and the one his species has never solved.
reference_stats.notes: Every advantage here is paired with a cost that is anatomical or institutional. The pairing is one authored fact seen twice: the tendril layer routes along vessels the host already owns and has no passage through a liver, so the ability that makes the hold possible is the same arrangement that fixes the ceiling. On the institutional side, a party that cannot be inspected is a party no office can rely on, which is why the first standard written for him is one he cannot satisfy. appearance.presentation: a lanternfolk-shaped body in which the luminous fungal colony died and a mineral bloom grew in the wound instead, so there is no glow anywhere on her, no faint light in the throat, and a stillness in the face that reads to strangers as composure
appearance.age: moving through the last of a short span, and entirely aware of the arithmetic, because her subspecies renews nothing and she is the only one of her line alive
appearance.build: a cave frame - long, low-shouldered and heat-tolerant - that has had nothing repaired in it for decades and has therefore learned to do everything with what is left
appearance.complexion: the waxy pallor of the deep ground, without the subsurface light that makes her parent readable in the dark, so she is a slightly less visible version of a thing everybody is used to seeing

appearance.eyes: unmediated, and the only thing about her that is unchanged: nobody answers before the question is finished, and after a lifetime of being the other kind she has not got used to how quiet that is

canon.role_in_story: Every curriculum in this setting is a wall. A gate is refused, and the refusal is the teaching; a body learns what it is by being told what it may not become. Her subspecies has no ceiling at all: a mineral bloom holds charge rather than transacting with it, which is structurally different from a colony and structurally unconstrained by it, so nothing in her anatomy refuses anything. She is therefore a body-path practitioner who cannot be taught by refusal, cannot be told when she has done enough, and cannot learn a discipline by running out of it. She went into the plains culture of the standing-in because it is the only community in this setting that has already invented an answer for a body that will not be around as long as the arrangement assumes, and its answer is that continuity is maintained by standing in and never by substituting a name. She is the standing-in, and the culture forbids the only remedy, and the reason it forbids it is that a substituted name would be a claim about somebody who is still alive.
canon.first_appearance: First seen on the stair at the hour it is least busy, standing well back from the handrail with both hands empty and her weight on a foot that was already tired, being asked by a woman coming up whether she wanted the rail, and answering that she did not, in a voice with no breath cost in it at all, which the woman subsequently described as the most frightening thing she had heard on the stair that week.
canon.lore:
Her subspecies is the control case, and the record is careful about that word. Her parent outsourced a nervous system to a fungal colony grown through the dermis and into the spinal cord, human tissue as the substrate and the colony as the organ, and the colony renewed neural tissue faster than a human frame does, which is why a lanternfolk is young for two hundred and fifty years and why their tenures, appointments and successions are all written in a clock most of the surface cannot survive. Her lineage's colony strain failed and a mineral bloom colonised the wound instead. The bloom cost the subspecies the two hundred and fifty years and gave back the mind path. What it did not give back is anything being repaired: a bloom holds, it does not transact, and a frame that renews nothing is a frame that has been quietly losing the same argument for a very long time.

She is on the body path, which is the one branch of the discipline that never consults the interior at all. That is not a coincidence and it is not a preference. Her subspecies has an unmediated interior - nothing answers before the question is finished - and that is the rarest and most valuable property any body in this setting has, because it is the only condition under which anybody can find out whether a symbiosis closed a whole species' mind path or the body plan did. Her parents could teach her the body path because they had it. Nobody could teach her the mind path because it was closed to them. So she is the control being maintained as a specimen, and she was assembled to hold an answer, and she is being trained on the branch that cannot give it up, and nobody anywhere is lying about any of that.

The body path's discipline is retention. Densification makes the frame heavier so that it holds. Refinement removes everything in the composition that is not load bearing. Integration is the point at which bone, muscle and fascia stop disagreeing with each other about what they are carrying. She can do all of it. She cannot feel any of it. A gate answered by holding can be described from the inside by everybody else in the setting, and on her the description has to come from outside, from a hand on the frame and a second pair of hands on a beam, and the second pair of hands is a person, and that person is now part of her progress in a way no other practitioner's progress is. She has been weighed more often than anyone else on this stair and every weighing has been a request.

The wall is the other problem, and it is the one that has made her strange rather than sad. Nothing refuses her. There is no rung in this ladder that can tell her to stop, no refusal to learn from, no limit to argue with. The ladder's whole pedagogy is a series of walls, and she has been handed a discipline whose every lesson is a wall and is standing in a body with none of them. So there is no moment at which she knows she is finished. A practitioner who is refused at a gate learns where their edge is. She will find out by being weighed, or by breaking something, and those are the same event and neither one is teaching. She has invented substitutes - a count of seasons, a written column, a set of private markers at the places her own frame gave out last time - and every one of them is worse than the wall she does not have, because none of them refuses her.

She came down off the high ground because the caverns enrol by counting out somebody else's remaining centuries and she has not got any, and she went into a plains culture rather than an office because the offices on the stair are all built out of a clock. The culture of the standing-in is wives left on the plains by the ascent, holding that nobody is to be counted twice, that an absent person is absent and is not spoken for, that household continuity is kept by standing in and never by substituting a name, and that the important date in a life is a departure. It is the only institution in this setting that has an office for exactly her, and the office has one rule she cannot satisfy.

She is standing in. The custom requires it, and the custom requires it because it is the only way the settlement does not end up claiming a person who has not agreed to be claimed. But the custom also forbids the remedy: nobody may substitute a name, nobody may count a child of the absent twice, and nobody may speak for a partner. So the arrangement has no exit, and it is the only arrangement in this setting that cannot be unwound by simply giving something up. She has noticed what that means, because a culture that forbids the remedy has decided that the standing-in is not a convenience, and she has not decided whether she agrees.

What she has not told anybody, and what the unwashed outer piece is not about, is the arithmetic she has been doing since the stair. A bloom holds rather than transacts, and every gate she opens leaves the frame holding a little more permanently than the last one, and the frame is not being repaired. So the discipline that is supposed to make a body last is, on her body, the discipline that is filling it up. She has not established that this is true. She has established that she cannot test it, that nobody else can test it, and that the only people who would know are the parent species she cannot go back to without losing the interior that makes her worth anything. She has decided to go on training. She has also decided, quietly, that this should be written down by somebody else while she is still here to disagree with it.
history: Came into being below the peaks when her lineage's colony strain failed and a mineral bloom colonised the wound, which cost the subspecies its two hundred and fifty years and gave back the mind path she has no use for, since she was trained on the branch that never consults the interior at all.

Was carried up off the high ground to be matched, and failed the match, and has never established whether that was because of the bloom or because the pairing was arranged by people who wanted an answer rather than a result.

Opened her first body gate somewhere below the third layer's working face with nobody coaching her, because her parents had the discipline and could teach it and there was no one within reach who could.

Came down the stair at the age her people would already be calling middle, on the grounds that the caverns enrol by counting out somebody else's remaining centuries and she has none to count, and joined a plains household that took her in as a standing-in without once asking her to be anything else.

Began being weighed by a woman from the stair office who needed two hands to do it, and has been weighed more often than any practitioner on that stair, and has never once been asked to hold still for a reading that was not about her own progress.

personality.summary: A body with no wall in it and no interior to feel one with, on a discipline whose every lesson is a refusal. She is unhurried, exacting, and unsentimental about her own decline, and she has taken a position in a household that forbids the only remedy its own rule would need.

relationships.note: A lanternfolk whose fungal colony died and was replaced by a mineral bloom, which cost the subspecies the two hundred and fifty years and gave back the mind path. The bloom holds charge instead of transacting with it, which is structurally unconstrained rather than merely unclosed, so no ceiling exists and nothing in her anatomy refuses anything.

A colony of fine luminous hyphae threaded through the dermis and into the spinal cord, human tissue as the substrate and the colony as the organ. The colony renewed neural tissue faster than a human frame does and is why a tenure below the peaks is written in centuries. She has neither the century nor the colony, and both of those are the same absence.

The first gate of the body ladder spends no charge and asks only that the composition be set rather than inherited. She seated it with no coach within reach, which is not a mark of talent and is the ordinary consequence of a subspecies nobody thought to build a curriculum for.

The first place the frame can be built around something other than habit, where the odds of the breakthrough holding fall and the falling is the whole cost curve of the path. On a frame where the denser the composition the more ways it can fail to close, and where nothing is being repaired, there is no way to read the fall in advance.

The culture of the absent: no child of the absent is counted twice, continuity is maintained by standing in and never by substituting a name, nobody is asked to speak for a partner, and the important date in a life is a departure. It is the only institution in the setting with an office that fits her, and its one rule is the one she cannot satisfy.

The one graded route out of the Mortal Plains and the setting's first portable institution, built because distance is not conserved on the plains. Every office on it is constituted out of a clock and every clock on it assumes a person who outlives the argument, which is the one assumption she is here to break.

reference_stats.summary: She fights with weight and refuses to move, and the strange part is that she has no idea how either is going. Everything she knows about her own frame arrives from outside: a hand, a beam, somebody else's opinion of a figure. Against anything patient she is very nearly unanswerable. Against anything in a hurry she loses, because she is the only one in the exchange waiting to be told how she is doing.
strengths: a frame that has been filling rather than renewing for decades and has therefore stopped doing anything the body path does not intend
no interior answers before the question is finished, which makes her the only reliable witness she has ever had
immovable once settled, because settling is the one thing she can still perform on demand
does not fatigue visibly, having no mechanism left that would show it
unfamiliar to every counter in the setting, because no office has ever had to write one
weaknesses: nothing about her is repaired, so a settled hold that costs her too much is paid for out of a stock that is not restocked
she cannot feel her own progress and has no interior to test it against
there is no rung in this ladder that can refuse her, so she has no external signal about when to stop
she is a bad fight in a hurry and knows it, which makes her the wrong body for a great deal of the setting
she is short of the time that every office around her is written against
reference_stats.combat_read: In a stand-off she is the safest body on the ground because she can afford the wait and cannot be told to stop. In a running exchange she is close to helpless, since the discipline she trained has nothing to say about timing and her body cannot report its own state. Anyone who wants to beat her needs to make her move before she has settled, and almost nobody in this setting is organised to do that.
reference_stats.notes: Every advantage here is paired with a cost that is anatomical or institutional. The pairing is one authored fact seen twice: the mineral bloom holds charge instead of transacting with it, which is why nothing refuses her, and it is also why nothing in her frame is being repaired, so the discipline that is supposed to make a body last is on her body the discipline that fills it up. On the institutional side, the culture she joined exists to maintain continuity by standing in and forbids substituting a name, which is the only exit it has. Nothing here states a mechanical rule the game does not: there is no authored consequence for an unconstrained frame that never renews, and any effect quantified in play should belong to the bloom and the beam rather than to a number attached to her.

appearance.presentation: a wader built to be in water and not out of it, long through the shin and broad through the hip, with the flat spread of a foot that has never once been asked to take a full load
appearance.age: late thirties, counted in wet seasons, which is the only calendar his household has ever used
appearance.build: heavy and low, the whole mass carried forward over three points of contact so that nothing he owns is ever above the water line
appearance.complexion: a marsh grey-green, slick in the wet and chalky at the edges where a dry day has got at it
appearance.hair: a heavy rope, kept because loose hair is a thing the flood takes and returns somewhere else
appearance.eyes: wide-set and low-lidded, reading the ground ahead of the body rather than the body itself
appearance.palette: reed brown, silt ochre, and the green-black of standing water with the sky not in it

appearance.marks: the pale silt line he carries at the knee and has stopped washing off, because it is the only honest gauge on him and the house has learned to read it instead of asking

canon.role_in_story: The charterhouse sells the only commodity the crossings charge for: a bed, a hot meal, and a person the Marshal's clerks will accept as a guarantor. Passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person and the law forbids levying a seat, so somebody has to stand behind every traveller. Quorl is the best guarantee the house has ever held and the one deposit it can never call. A marshfolk's stance is three points distributed over splayed toes and a tail-prop, so the heel never takes a full load and the wading frame is not built to be picked up and carried anywhere. The body path pays in weight - densification makes the frame heavier so that it holds - and heavier is precisely what his frame cannot put anywhere it counts. He has been getting better for twenty years at a discipline whose whole reward is a thing his body will not accept, and the house has been getting safer to leave things with, which is the opposite exchange and the only one on offer.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the ford bar at the hour the house changes its board, standing in the water with a traveller's pack already on his forward point and one hand out to take the second traveller's elbow, having come out of the channel rather than off the bank, because coming in off the bank would have put him in front of the clerk and the clerk writes things down.
canon.lore:
The house exists because the crossings charge for the only unit of supply there is, and a traveller cannot simply be entered as an asset against the crossing debt, so the road needs a body who will stand behind one. That is the whole product: a bed, a stew kept at simmer from first light and never allowed to finish, and a person the Marshal's clerks will accept. Everything else the house does is marketing. He is the best guarantee it has held because he has never failed to hold, and because he does not lose weight, and because he is present every hour of every year by rotation without a roster and without a wage, which is the entire economic advantage of his species and also its entire trap.

His species' stance is the problem and the problem is structural. Three points of contact over splayed toes and a tail-prop means the heel never takes a full load. That is not a limp and it is not a wound. It is how the frame is built for wading, and it means there is no posture in which his own body will take his whole weight at once. He can stand. He cannot load. Those are separate properties and the body path needs the second one.

Because the body path pays in weight, this is the one species in the setting for which the reward and the frame's own refusal are the same fact. Densification is retention: the frame is made heavier so that it will hold. Refinement strips out everything in the composition that is not load bearing, which is harder work on a body that is already mostly load bearing. Integration is the point where bone, muscle and fascia stop disagreeing about what they are carrying, and on a wading frame they were never going to. He has done all of it. He is denser than anybody in that house and he is the only one of them who cannot be put down. Two hundredweight of technique distributed across three points is still distributed across three points.

The ceiling is where the ceiling always is on this kind of frame, and it is a ceiling rather than a closure, which the record is careful about and which the house is not. The heel vessels are the pair that would have to be pressurised together for anything higher, and a wading frame that lowers its core and distributes its load across three points has no way to hold two of them at once. So there is a rung on this ladder he will never pass, and the ladder above it is entirely still there, and this is the part that people get wrong when they feel sorry for him: nothing about his frame refuses the path. Nothing about his frame refuses anything. It simply stops being able to answer one question, at a rung, and the refusal is a fact about ankles rather than about his species' prospects.

Which is why the deposition arrangement is what it is. A house on a road whose product is a guarantor cannot use a body that cannot be carried, so it has learned to hold everything in him instead: the goods a traveller cannot take, a debt a traveller cannot pay on arrival, a deposit nobody will put in a stranger's hands. He is the safest place on that road for anything you would not leave in a locked room, and the reason is a frame that cannot be moved. Every one of those arrangements is a compliment. Every one of them is also the same fact, and the house has never once asked him whether he would rather be carried.

He has worked out, and told nobody, that the reason the deposits keep growing is the discipline. A denser frame is a frame that cannot be picked up, and a frame that cannot be picked up is a better guarantee, and the house has been quietly improving its own security by paying for his improvement without intending to. He has told nobody because being told he is useful is the most valuable thing that has ever happened to him and he does not trust it to survive being examined. He has also worked out that the technique is the only thing he owns that is getting better, and that he has no way of putting it anywhere except here.

What he wants is a measure. Not a rung, not a gate, a measure: some account of his own progress that does not require a second person with a hand on him and a clerk with a board, because the practice of asking him how far he has come has quietly become the reason the technique is hard to do. He has started leaving marks in the silt at the ford, at the height of his own knee, at the three points he actually uses, because the silt keeps them and nobody has ever thought to read them. The house has found them and has not mentioned them, and he has not either, and the two of them are now running a small shared silence about a gauge in the mud.
history: Was born on the margin in a flood year and has never lived on ground that stayed wet without his having to find it first, which is the whole of his childhood and is not remembered as hardship.

Took the ford crossing as a boy because it was the only work on the road that did not require being picked up, and discovered within a season that standing in water is not the same as being loaded and that nobody on that road distinguishes the two.
Opened his first body gate in his late twenties at a standing cost of almost nothing, and worked out inside a year that the cost was not going to rise, and told nobody that either.

Began taking the house's deposits the year the previous holder's hands failed, and has not let one of them go missing since, which is the entire basis of his standing and is also the reason he cannot leave.

Started cutting his own marks in the silt at the ford, at knee height, at the three points he actually uses, because he could not find an instrument for his own progress that did not require somebody else to operate it.

personality.summary: A wader from the only ground that stays wet through the dry season, on the path that pays him in weight, which is the one thing his frame cannot place anywhere it counts. He is good-humoured, uncomplaining, and quietly exact about a number nobody has ever asked him for.

relationships.note: A wading amphibian lineage that breathes air and nests on floating mats, standing on three points over splayed toes and a tail-prop. The heel never takes a full load, which is how the frame is built and not a defect in it, and which is the reason nothing about this body will ever be loaded.

The first gate of the body ladder, which asks that the composition be set rather than inherited and costs the four digestive meridians open with no charge spent at all. He seated it in his late twenties and every gate above it has cost more and bought less, which is the ordinary shape of the path on a frame that was never going to be rewarded by it.

A stance that spends the whole body's weight instead of its speed, with nothing elemental in it, existing for the single purpose of making the practitioner impossible to move while it is held. It is the exact answer to his frame's refusal and it requires a single loaded base, and a wader does not have one.

The one ordinary vessel whose work is bookkeeping rather than strength, holding what the body has decided not to spend, and harm there exhausts quietly and last so it goes unreported for years. He spends everything he draws and holds nothing, so the vessel that would record the withholding is permanently empty in him too. Its authored tier is a separate axis from any rung and nothing about it is a ladder position.

The roadside house selling a bed, a stew kept at simmer from first light and a person the Marshal's clerks will accept as a guarantor, existing because the law forbids levying a seat and passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person. It has improved its own security for years without intending to, by paying for a practice that makes its guarantor impossible to move.

The run moves its bed far enough between floods to relocate every settlement on it, and its channel is dry most of the year, so the margin beside it and not the river is what a body that must stay wet actually lives on. Every ford on it is re-found rather than maintained, and he is on the water every time that happens.

reference_stats.summary: He fights from inside the water, weight low and travelling, closing with all three points rather than driving from one. He does not fight often. What he is for is holding a place in a channel, or holding a thing that has been left with him, and he has held both for longer than most people in this setting have been standing.
strengths: the densest frame on that road by a margin nobody has measured and everybody has felt
immovable while three points are down, which is a different kind of immovability from a stance
reads a bed, a bank and a current by pressure alone, in the dark and under load
carries far more than a wader of his apparent weight is expected to carry
present every hour of every year without a roster and without complaint, which is a military property
weaknesses: cannot be picked up, so every task anybody ever wanted to give him has had to be given in a form that does not involve leaving
cannot load a single point, so the technique that would make him truly immovable is unavailable
there is a rung on this ladder he will not pass, and the ladder above it is still there and still open
his skin dries fast out of the water and the dry season is weeks of careful scheduling
his progress is only knowable by an instrument somebody else has to operate
reference_stats.combat_read: Anywhere soft, shallow and slow, he is very nearly unkillable and the ground provides no counter. On anything hard he is out of his depth before the exchange starts, and the honest reading is that he has no fighting ground outside the one stretch of water he is standing in. He would be told to hold a line and he would hold it, and the line would be a channel, and everyone involved would be satisfied.
reference_stats.notes: Every advantage here is paired with a cost that is anatomical or institutional, and each pair is one authored fact seen twice. His species' three-point stance is why a denser frame is also a frame that cannot be lifted, so the discipline that makes him stronger is the same discipline that makes him immovable and therefore indispensable and immobile. The ceiling at the heel vessels is a ceiling and not a closed path: nothing about his species refuses the body path and the ladder above that rung remains open in principle. Nothing here states a rule the game does not: no mechanical consequence has been written for a body-path practitioner whose frame refuses to load, and any effect quantified in play should belong to the stance and the water rather than to a figure attached to him.

canon.role_in_story: An emberhollow buys the fastest cultivation rate in the setting and pays for it with lung tissue that scars on a clock the frame cannot outrun, and for both of those the mechanism is the same: the meridian set is the ash parent's, already loaded with a mineral the blood is filtering out of the air, and the fire parent contributes throughput and no capacity at all. So nothing she takes in is ever stored, every gain arrives and is spent in the same breath, and the discipline that is supposed to make a body last is on her body the discipline that burns it off. What nobody on the belt has costed is where the throughput comes from. The Ember Ley is fed from below: the surplus law the top tier's surface cannot carry rises off it, drifts, and settles, and behaves like weather rather than like a river. She is not fast. She is on a supply line, and a supply line has an owner, and the owner has never once been asked what it is spending her on.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing at the edge of a queue at the ley with both hands behind her back and her face turned away from the crowd, answering nothing, while a tally clerk worked down the line and put a mark beside her name without stopping, because he had reached her the first time in eleven seasons and had already been told what she would say about it.
canon.lore:
The belt runs on one fact: elemental law is unspent across the lower tiers, so an affinity and every elemental technique arrive at full strength and produce nothing at all. The same technique works at the ley. That asymmetry pulls every fire practitioner in the setting into one valley, and the valley is licensed because the top tier writes elemental law and writes it twice. She has lived inside that asymmetry her entire adult life and has drawn a wage from it, and she is the only person on the belt who has asked where the ley's fire comes from.

It comes from below. The top tier's surface seats more law than it can hold, and the excess does not sit there: it rises off the surface, drifts, and settles, and it behaves like weather rather than like a river. That drift is what the shelf above is made of and what feeds the ley from underneath. So the fire that has made her the fastest cultivator anybody has on file is not a property of her body at all. It is a delivery, and it is denominated in somebody else's unspent budget, and the belt has spent several centuries treating it as a feature of the ground rather than as an arrangement. She has read enough of the top tier's law census to know which half of the arithmetic is the interesting half.

The other half is her body. The meridian set she inherited is the ash parent's, which arrived already loaded with a mineral the blood filters out of the air, and the liver is the filter and the last of the ordinary vessels. The fire parent contributed throughput and no capacity, which means the frame takes a charge in at a rate nothing in this setting matches and has nowhere to put it, so nothing she takes in is ever stored. Every gain arrives and is spent in the same breath. Densification, which is the whole of what the body path can actually be, is a transaction with no other side, and the eighth gate is a wall in an organ her own rate is continuously taxing. The gift and the deadline are one fact and not two facts, and every account of her species that presents them as a bargain has quietly split them.

Her household holds the cinder-mark's eating rules: nothing is wasted and nothing is hoarded, the last portion on the plate is the largest obligation a person has, and nothing needing a fire may be counted against a fuel nobody in the room has. She lives inside the most austere eating arrangement the setting has and is fed at the one table that permits a hot dish, and she has been arguing for years that the belt should stop calling her fast. Her argument is arithmetic and it is unwelcome: the throughput is a delivery from a surplus nobody here owns, the frame is the container, and a settlement that spends a container and pays the supplier nothing has not found a fast body. It has found a cheap one. The household's answer is that the distinction is a ledger entry and she is not being asked to run the ledger.

The second-layer drift has one property that matters more than the rest and that she has not been able to put anywhere. There is no regrowth at any rate. It pools, drifts and settles, and once a supply has been taken it is not replenished from the same place, because nothing up there grows anything back. So the rate that has made her valuable is a stock being drawn down rather than a river being tapped, and a stock drawn down can be closed by whoever holds it, and the only party in this setting with any standing to close it is a body that cannot be reached by ordinary means and has never been asked to consent to anything.

She has noticed what her rate is worth and what it costs and has put the two on the same sheet, which is the one act nobody on the belt has performed, and the sheet says that her throughput rises when the drift is running and falls when it is not, and that her decline runs on a clock that does not care. She has said none of this out loud in a form anyone has written down, because writing it down on the belt would put her name beside a claim about another world and there is no office she could take such a claim to. She has, however, taken a job at the ley that pays her to stand at the edge of the seam and tell people what their fire is worth, which is a job nobody wanted because it produces no money and is the only post on the belt where the question is asked out loud.

What she wants is narrow and she has stopped disguising it. She wants the belt to be told what it is spending, by somebody with standing, in a form that survives her. She has calculated, on the ordinary arithmetic, that she will not. She has decided to keep doing the work at the seam anyway, because it is the only place the question is permitted to be asked, and because a woman who stopped being useful while arguing about the price of the thing she is useful for would lose the argument in a way she would not be able to detect.
history: Was produced on the same belt of the same arc as every other crossing of a fire body and an ash body, in a generation where the crossing was common enough to be ordinary and has since become the rarest body on it.
Leared young that the rate is not hers, because the first body-path technique she was ever shown failed on her the moment the ley did not run, and nobody in the room could say why.

Opened her first ordinary gate at sixteen, faster than the local instructors could follow, and was from that point entered in the belt's talent lists by people who could not tell what they had actually measured.

Took the post at the ley edge because it was the only one that let her ask out loud what the seam was worth and who was being paid for it, and has stood it every working day since, saying the same thing to a stream of people who come to have their fire appraised.

Read the top tier's own surplus arithmetic from a ledger left open in a public hall, worked out which half of the delivery was hers to spend, and has said the resulting sentence to exactly one person, who wrote it down and has not yet asked her whether it can be said publicly.

personality.summary: The fastest body on the belt, on a supply line somebody else owns, in a household that eats by the rules of a famine which ended a century ago. She is exact about the arithmetic, unsentimental about the deadline, and far more interested in the price of her own advantage than in being allowed to keep it.

relationships.note: The crossing of a fire body with an ash body. It buys the fastest cultivation rate in the setting by a margin nobody has explained and pays for it with lung tissue that scars on a clock the frame cannot outrun, and the two are one fact: the ash parent's mineral load filters through the liver, the fire parent adds throughput and no capacity, so nothing is ever stored.

The first gate of the body ladder costs the four digestive meridians open and no charge at all. She seated it at sixteen in less time than the local instructors could follow, and has never been able to reproduce the sitting under any other conditions since.

The slow upward movement of the surplus law the top tier's surface cannot carry, which is what the shelf above is made of and what feeds the ley from below. It pools, drifts and settles, and behaves like weather rather than a river. It is a delivery with an owner, and there is no regrowth at any rate, so a supply taken is a supply drawn down.

The households the Cinder Famine left, holding that nothing is wasted and nothing is hoarded and that the last portion on the plate is the largest obligation a person has, and eating nothing that needs a fire beyond the store's own lamp. She is fed at the one table where a hot dish is served, which is the arrangement's whole reward and also its leash.

The first ground in the setting where fire is simply fire, licensed because this tier writes elemental law and writes it twice, and which the two lower tiers left unspent so that an affinity and every elemental technique run at full strength and produce nothing. The same technique works here, and that asymmetry has drawn every fire practitioner in the setting to one valley.

The custom of spending the last hour before a settlement falls silent at the trading floor, keeping up a hum no buyer admits to making. She stands the seam through that hour because the seam does not keep hours, and she has never worked out whether the hum is hers or the ground's.

reference_stats.summary: She fights at a rate nobody in this setting can match and holds nothing back, because there is nothing to hold back. Every gain arrives and is spent in the same breath, so the pressure of her attacks is unanswerable while the frame absorbing them is on a clock. She is the most dangerous body on the belt for about as long as she will be dangerous.
strengths: a throughput no other frame in the setting matches, sustained for as long as the supply beneath her runs
genuinely unkillable inside a completed passage, because there is no resident in her for an attack to find
reads intent in a crowd at the speed of a struck match and is almost never wrong about the reading
carries no store, so a siege, a deprivation and a surprise reserve are all irrelevant to her
cheaper than any specialist the belt could otherwise hire, which is the only reason she has been left alone
weaknesses: the decline is on a fixed clock that no amount of practice moves and that a breakthrough does not pause
there is a wall in a liver her own rate is taxing, so the faster she goes the less the wall moves
her advantage depends on a supply from another world that anybody with standing could stop
her lungs scar whether she trains or not, and the scarring is the reason there is a deadline at all
she holds nothing, so she cannot spend a moment's gains on a later moment's need
reference_stats.combat_read: In any exchange shorter than her remaining span she is simply the best body in the room, and no counter in the setting is authored against a throughput. Over anything longer the frame is the problem: the scarring is a clock rather than a wound, so a fight she wins leaves her exactly where the fight did, and a careful opponent's whole strategy is to refuse to stop and let the arithmetic do the work.
reference_stats.notes: Every advantage here is paired with a cost that is anatomical or institutional. The pairing is one authored fact seen twice: the throughput that makes her the fastest body in the setting is a delivery from the second layer's surplus drift rather than a property of her frame, and it is denominated in another world's unspent budget with no regrowth at any rate. The belt's institutions take the delivery as a feature of the ground, which is what converts a stock into an apparently free supply and leaves her as the only party in the arrangement with nothing to bargain with. Nothing here states a mechanical rule the game does not: no authored consequence exists for a supply line that can be closed, and any effect quantified in play should belong to the drift and the frame rather than to a figure attached to her name.

art.palette_notes: Ley orange against ash grey with the light coming up through the floor of every frame, so the underside of her jaw and the inside of her forearms are always the brightest things in the picture. She never casts a warm shadow of her own making; the only cool light anywhere in her sequences is the borrowed daylight of a working morning and it appears exactly twice, and both times she is standing outside the seam rather than on it.
